name: WorldgenNext
description: Faster chunk generation that produces the same world. Terrain and surface for tested world generators (vanilla, Terralith, Tectonic) are computed on the GPU through Vulkan; structure, carver and feature steps run in parallel; chunks are saved in the background. Includes a pregenerator: /worldgennext pregen start <radius>. Works on dedicated servers and in singleplayer; settings in config/worldgennext.toml; /worldgennext status shows what is active.
